inputMethod: CDP trusted touch and keyboard; named touchEnd lifts an individual thumb on Chromium WebTouch path

touchProvenance.individualRelease: touchEnd with only the released contact; remaining contacts stay stationary and active
touchProvenance.finalRelease: touchEnd with an empty point list
touchProvenance.note: Primary source inspected: WebTouch erases supplied touchEnd IDs; active-point omission releases belong to the optional SyntheticPointerActions branch. Protocol documentation differs from the default WebTouch implementation.

lifecycleMethod: Pause/phase/departure use supplied public views; trusted CDP keyboard repeat stays held across pause/phase/blur until a real key-up and fresh key-down. Trusted same-contact touch moves exercise release after blur/visibility, followed by touchEnd and a fresh touchStart. Blur/refocus and document-hidden/visible signals are explicitly synthetic handler tests.
